item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI takes players to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City. The game features dual protagonists Lucia and her partner, marking the first female lead in the mainline series. Set in a modern-day Vice City inspired by Miami, GTA VI promises to deliver the most immersive and ambitious open world Rockstar has ever created.

item.title: Megastore Simulator - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Megastore Simulator is a first-person management & tycoon game. Start small and grow into a massive two-floor megastore with forklifts, pallet jacks, and staff. Unlock and run Bakery, Clothing, Electronics, Sports, Music, Toy & Grocery departments.

item.title: Party Party Anxiety! - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: A dating card game for anxious people. Use conversation cue cards up your sleeves to make connections. But beware—the more anxious you get, the scarier they become.

item.title: Project Killdance - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Project KILLDANCE is a Noir tactical action featuring a one-army strategy and instant-death combat. Slowly observe surroundings, choreograph each killing move, leave no survivor, and become the spectral death.

item.title: Convenience Store Simulator - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: A game about running and managing your own convenience store. Actively work the register, master stock and inventory, make and sell coffee, hire unique staff, and fully decorate your space. Strategically expand your business and play special mini-games for prizes.

item.title: Relative Frame - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Explore space in a hand crafted, physics based universe, with immersive sound and atmosphere. Fight and board ships, collect rare cargo, and upgrade your ship.

item.title: Dune: Awakening - Raiders of the Broken Lands - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Raiders of the Broken Lands DLC features a cosmetic pack inspired by the Smugglers of the Imperium. Customize your base with 74 building pieces and 17 decorations, and take the smuggler style into the desert with new armor, weapon, and vehicle variants, a cosmetic swatch, and emotes.

item.title: Trinket Bag Maker - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Trinket Bag Maker is a retro sandbox game inspired by the 2000's girl games, where you can create your own trinket bag! Choose between many adorable charms and bags to create the trinket bag of your dreams!

item.title: Dino Party - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: a chaotic multiplayer brawler packed with silly physics, unpredictable minigames, and over-the-top dino action.

item.title: Bruisers 2D Boxing - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description:
Step into the ring and fight your way to the top in Bruisers 2D Boxing — a gritty, retro-styled boxing RPG where every punch counts and every decision shapes your career.
Welcome to the unforgiving world of professional boxing. Build your legacy from the ground up — train hard, fight smart, and manage the life of an up-and-coming fighter chasing glory. With in-depth 2D boxing action and a rich career mode, Bruisers 2D Boxing captures the raw intensity of the sport like never before.

item.title: It's Fine - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: It’s Fine is an active incremental/upgrade clicker game about releasing v1.0 of your game on time.

item.title: Glue Blocks - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Glue your falling blocks to create your own shapes and achieve monster scores in wells of all shapes with dynamic gravity. Compete with friends or have funds in coop. And unleash your own creativity with the mode and well editor!

item.title: Bounce95 - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Incremental game where you bounce balls on stages you create

item.title: Word95 - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Play word games and get points to build a dictionary one word at a time

item.title: Trees Hate You - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

item.title: Curse Chapter: Dawnthief - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Plunder all the treasure worth taking from the exotic wilderness with your band of rogues. Jump, kick and sling your chain mace to smash and climb your way through any obstacle. Face off against beasts and hopeful heroes that rise up to stop you.

item.title: Dzyun Battle 2026 - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Strafe, jump, and battle for holiday supremacy! Join Team Santa or Team Krampus in high-speed New Year PvP!

item.title: Neidfyre - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.

item.title: Auto Snakes in Outer Space - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: A hypnotic incremental idler where you manage colorful snakes. Watch them collect food, then spend the food on upgrades and abilities for your colony.

item.title: Fate Architect - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Fate Architect is a roguelike deckbuilder where you build and modify symbols on a slot machine to earn points and shape your strategy. Each run offers new combinations, synergies, and challenges as you design the ultimate slot machine of fate.

item.title: Orium - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Aboard your ship, exterminate the enemies of profit, exploit planets and expand the corporation’s commercial empire across the stars. Orium is a roguelite infused with streamlined 4X elements.

item.title: Simpli Casa - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Welcome to Simpli Casa, the chill and addictive decorating game where minimalism meets maximum style!

item.title: Cute Finders - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Your mission starts now! Objective? Find the subtle, silly, and sneaky differences between the two images displayed!

item.title: Feast of the Beast: Unleashed - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: "Top-down action and survival shooter, playable solo or cooperatively. Explore Valachia with your brother and face off against humans, lycanthropes, and rival vampire clans as you advance towards the origin of TOX-Z, the toxin that consumes the world."

item.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Voyage across and beneath the salt-stricken seas in this thrilling nautically-themed expansion of Hollow Knight: Silksong, free for all players in 2026!

item.title: Inferno Protocol - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Trapped in a deadly labyrinth, you and 5 friends must scavenge, craft, and survive. Harvest monster parts for gear, inject experimental syringes to gain unique skills, and navigate trap-filled corridors. In this 6-player horror survival, you must evolve to escape.

item.title: Highway Noir - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: You are an underground driver for hire, fired from the Major Crimes Agency. Rush through a busy city at night as you take on high speed getaways, dangerous street races, white knuckle pursuits and more. Don't stop until you reveal the truth about who wanted you gone

item.title: Joint Force - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Solve challenging puzzles to reunite Belcho and Nim.

item.title: Anxiety Arcade - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Anxiety Arcade is a short, surreal narrative game about living with anxiety — and how it feels when your own thoughts turn into puzzles.

item.title: Thirsty Princess - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Thirsty Princess is a fast-paced, top-down party game for 2–4 local players where you and your friends compete to drink beer with an impatient and unreasonable princess. Get drunk and slowly lose control while you brawl, steal from and sabotage your friends to win the favour of your princess.

item.title: D.A.D.S. - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Use your special ops units to construct base facilities and towers to protect them from the ever-increasing threat of alien invaders in this Tower Defense game with a city-building element! Research their weaknesses and develop defenses before mankind runs out of time.

item.title: Morbid Mailroom - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: In a claymation prison for occult offenders, you are the package inspector. Search packages for hidden contraband, coded letters, and cursed objects. Balance duty, compassion, and survival as you decide what reaches the inmates and what burns in the incinerator. Your choices cannot be undone.

item.title: Stunted Gravity - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game set in a neon-dystopian future. Race, jump, and improvise lines across arenas where gravity pulls in any and every direction. Execute stunts, evade hazards, and battle enemy drones as you pilot though the interplanetary Stunted Gravity Circuit.

item.title: Don Pepe y sus globos - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Don Pepe y sus globos is a multiplayer party game where up to 4 players can duke it out... with water balloons! Reload, avoid and throw to fight - whoever's still dry at the end wins!

item.title: Beandejo - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: BEANDEJO is an action-packed spin-gun roguelite. Enter the Old West, where the cattle roam, and drunken vegetables terrorize the local saloons. Spin your gun, time your draws, and gun them down to become the toughest sheriff in town!

item.title: Ephemeral Frame - 2026 Release Date & Platforms
item.description: Step inside picture frames, films, and other imagery that connect a variety of dreamscapes in this surreal first-person exploration game.
